data.rationale: The proposed workflow follows the same sequence (Booking search, xe.com EUR conversion, mail draft with the same subject and body), but it leaves out the 8+ review-score hotel criterion and the "do not click Reserve" constraint. It also says "Send or discard" where the true workflow requires Discard and forbids Send, and it uses recipient_email instead of a traveler name that builds {traveler}@example.com. The body template has inconsistent placeholders ({name}, {hotel}, {price}), and "pick a hotel" is vague, so an automation built from the spec would be partly ambiguous and could send the email.
